related.title: OPA：未定義回應與應用整合的封閉失敗
related.titleEn: OPA: undefined responses and fail-closed integration contracts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：60%與73.333%由交集重算，內部網段無效身分仍拒絕；服務通過不自動授權使用者動作。 交付beyondprod-edges.csv、兩種交換負例及准入差異報告；資料中沒有真實公司服務拓樸。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 60 and approximately 73.333 percent from the intersection. Reject invalid internal identities and preserve a separate decision for user operations. Deliver beyondprod-edges.csv, identity/build substitution counterexamples and a decision-difference report. The topology is fictional and contains no real organizational service map.
related.difference: 建立10個離線HTTP回應描述，保留狀態碼、JSON內容、查詢路徑及政策修訂；實作只在明確result=true時通過的解析器。
related.differenceEn: Build ten offline HTTP-response descriptors with status code, JSON body, query path and policy revision. Implement a parser that admits only explicit boolean result=true, avoiding language truthiness or assumptions that successful transport implies authorization.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本地准入規則要求身分與核准來源兩項都成立；使用者操作權限另外評估。集合交集只計服務層通過率，不能解讀為終端使用者都獲授權。 15條合成呼叫邊中12條身分有效，其中9條也有核准來源；另3條身分無效，即使來自內部網段仍拒絕。 服務層通過率9/15×100=60%；補齊兩條既有有效身分邊的來源證據後為11/15×100≈73.333%。
資料API的HTTP成功與授權允許是不同層；缺result、解析錯誤、false及型別錯誤在本地契約一律不授權，但保留各自診斷原因。 10筆中4筆為布林true、3筆false、2筆缺result、1筆字串true；字串即使非空也不當成允許。 正確通過率4/10×100=40%；修正兩個缺result回應為可驗證的布林true後為6/10×100=60%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The local service gate requires both workload identity and approved provenance. Evaluate end-user operation rights separately. The intersection measures service-layer eligibility only and must not be reported as authorization for every user behind an eligible service. Of 15 synthetic call edges, 12 have acceptable identity and nine of those also have approved provenance. Three invalid-identity edges remain rejected even when their source addresses belong to the internal subnet. Service-layer eligibility is 9/15×100=60 percent. Supplying acceptable provenance for two existing identity-valid edges raises it to 11/15×100, approximately 73.333 percent, without changing the total population.

Successful transport and permission are different layers. Under the local contract, missing result, parse error, false and incorrect type all withhold authorization while retaining distinct diagnostic reasons for operational repair. The ten rows contain four boolean true results, three false results, two absent results and one string containing true. A nonempty string must not gain authority through the host language truthiness rules. Correct admission is 4/10×100=40 percent. Repairing the two absent-result cases into verified boolean true responses yields 6/10×100=60 percent; the malformed string remains rejected.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: in-toto：獨立功能者門檻與產物規則消耗
related.titleEn: in-toto: functionary thresholds and artifact-rule consumption
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：60%與73.333%由交集重算，內部網段無效身分仍拒絕；服務通過不自動授權使用者動作。 交付beyondprod-edges.csv、兩種交換負例及准入差異報告；資料中沒有真實公司服務拓樸。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 60 and approximately 73.333 percent from the intersection. Reject invalid internal identities and preserve a separate decision for user operations. Deliver beyondprod-edges.csv, identity/build substitution counterexamples and a decision-difference report. The topology is fictional and contains no real organizational service map.
related.difference: 建立兩個功能者link、核准keyid與materials/products清單；依MATCH、ALLOW及最後DISALLOW規則逐個消耗佇列，保留未被消耗的產物名稱。
related.differenceEn: Build two functionary links, authorized key IDs and material/product inventories. Apply MATCH, ALLOW and a final DISALLOW rule to the artifact queue, preserving the names of products not consumed by earlier rules.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本地准入規則要求身分與核准來源兩項都成立；使用者操作權限另外評估。集合交集只計服務層通過率，不能解讀為終端使用者都獲授權。 15條合成呼叫邊中12條身分有效，其中9條也有核准來源；另3條身分無效，即使來自內部網段仍拒絕。 服務層通過率9/15×100=60%；補齊兩條既有有效身分邊的來源證據後為11/15×100≈73.333%。
功能者門檻與產物規則是獨立關卡；本課計算未核准產物佔比，所有名稱先正規化且不把同一路徑不同摘要合併。 單一步驟輸出10個產物，其中8個被明訂規則消耗，2個剩餘；兩位有效功能者已滿足門檻且內容一致。 剩餘比例(10−8)/10×100=20%；補上一條僅核准其中一個既定產物的精確規則後剩10%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The local service gate requires both workload identity and approved provenance. Evaluate end-user operation rights separately. The intersection measures service-layer eligibility only and must not be reported as authorization for every user behind an eligible service. Of 15 synthetic call edges, 12 have acceptable identity and nine of those also have approved provenance. Three invalid-identity edges remain rejected even when their source addresses belong to the internal subnet. Service-layer eligibility is 9/15×100=60 percent. Supplying acceptable provenance for two existing identity-valid edges raises it to 11/15×100, approximately 73.333 percent, without changing the total population.

Functionary threshold and artifact rules are independent gates. Measure the fraction of unapproved products after path normalization, while retaining different digests for an identical path rather than merging conflicting evidence into a single harmless-looking entry. One step emits ten products, eight consumed by explicit rules and two remaining. Two valid functionaries already satisfy the threshold and agree on contents, isolating artifact-policy completeness from signer-count failure. Remaining fraction is (10−8)/10×100=20 percent. Adding an exact rule approving only one previously reviewed product leaves ten percent, and the final DISALLOW still rejects the remaining unexpected output.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
